content:
I didn't use doc-gen locally till now as I'd like to quickly debug some formatting issue, but I encountered a problem where after the initial build it doesn't rebuild after code changes. Here are steps to reproduce on a clean project

  • Use vscode to create a project (no mathlib needed)
  • Modify lean-toolchain to leanprover/lean4:v4.31.0-rc2 (doc-gen master uses this)
  • Follow https://github.com/leanprover/doc-gen4/blob/main/README.md to create docbuild/lakefile.toml, and lake update doc-gen4
  • lake build the project outside, then DOCGEN_SRC="file" lake build YourLibraryName:docs inside docbuild. Verify the doc is correctly generated
  • Add a doc string to the code. Repeat the building step again. Find that the doc doesn't update
  • Remove the html file and build doc, and find that it doesn't regenerate

Did I miss anything obvious?
